title: Представление против функции
verify: SELECT 'lang' AS kind, p.proname::text AS v, l.lanname::text AS w FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_language l ON l.oid = p.prolang WHERE p.proname IN ('fnc_persons_female', 'fnc_persons_male') AND p.pronamespace = current_schema()::regnamespace UNION ALL SELECT 'female', f::text, '' FROM fnc_persons_female() AS f UNION ALL SELECT 'male', m::text, '' FROM fnc_persons_male() AS m ORDER BY 1, 2

negative.sql:
CREATE FUNCTION fnc_persons_female() RETURNS SETOF person AS $$ BEGIN RETURN QUERY SELECT * FROM person WHERE gender = 'female'; END; $$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;
CREATE FUNCTION fnc_persons_male() RETURNS SETOF person AS $$ BEGIN RETURN QUERY SELECT * FROM person WHERE gender = 'male'; END; $$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;
